chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Aban ibn Uthman from Humran ibn A'yan said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Talbiyah, and he said to me, 'Respond with the Hajj [call]. When you enter Mecca, perform Tawaf around the House, pray, and perform Ihlal.' And he also narrated this.

key_terms.أَحْلَلْتَ: You performed Ihlal (ending the state of Ihram)
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: The ritual call of 'Labbayk' recited during Hajj

ai.seo_question: What are the steps for performing Hajj upon entering Mecca according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the sequence of Hajj rituals, linking the declaration of Talbiyah with the transition from Ihram to Ihlal upon entering Mecca. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s and Imams’ practical guidance in structuring the pilgrimage rites, ensuring the pilgrim’s spiritual state aligns with the physical acts of worship.
